content.short: Radiant Capital is an omnichain money market that unifies fragmented liquidity across all major blockchain networks.
content.description: Radiant Capital is a pioneering decentralized finance protocol designed to solve the problem of fragmented liquidity by enabling users to interact with a single, unified money market across multiple chains. Built on top of LayerZero technology, the platform allows participants to deposit collateral on one network—such as Arbitrum—and borrow assets natively on another, like BNB Chain or Ethereum. This approach significantly enhances capital efficiency. Powered by the RDNT token, the protocol features a unique Dynamic Liquidity model that incentivizes long-term participation via revenue-sharing.
content.meta: Radiant Capital provides omnichain lending and borrowing services for fragmented liquidity. Discover Radiant and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
